entities.summary: Dmitry Vlasyevich Aynalov was a Soviet and Russian art historian, a university professor, a corresponding member of the Saint Petersburg Academy of Sciences (1914), and a member of the Imperial Orthodox Palestine Society. He penned more than 200 scholarly publications, including articles, lectures, reviews.
